name: FLUX.3 Klein distilled — fast picture edit
title: Edit a picture in seconds
summary: Describe a change — a new style, colour, object or light — and get the edited picture. The result keeps your picture's shape and layout; a box can point at exactly what to change.
description: Edit a picture by describing the change, with Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein distilled build (16 steps). Refer to your picture as <ref_image_0>, and say what must stay the same as well as what changes — or, as Black Forest Labs recommend, describe the finished picture in full with the edit folded in. The AI improver ("Improve the instruction with AI") looks at your picture and writes the full instruction for you, but adds about 2 to 3 minutes; otherwise write the instruction in full. The result keeps the shape of your picture. To change one exact thing, draw a box around it over your picture and cite it as <obj_1> in the instruction; say in words what must stay.
author: Template - ComfyUI (FLUX.3 Image Klein)

exposedParameters.label: What to change
exposedParameters.default: In <ref_image_0>, give her a pair of large gold hoop earrings; keep her face, hair, clothes, pose and the background exactly the same.

exposedParameters.label: Layout — optional boxes (use Compose layout; cite box N in the prompt as <obj_N>)
Improve the instruction with AI first (a Qwen 3.5 model looks at the picture and writes a full caption of the result) — slow: adds about 2–3 minutes
Working size (megapixels) — the result takes the picture's shape at this size

promptGuides.label: FLUX.3 prompting basics (Black Forest Labs)
promptGuides.tip: Write the caption in full (or let the AI improver write it, about 2 to 3 minutes): medium first, then the scene, the light, the camera and where each subject sits.
